ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation COMPRESS OBFUSCATION - Security
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via COMPRESS OBFUSCATION Note: Unmapped fields: ServiceFileName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4697 AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*new\\-object.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*text\\\.encoding\\]\\:\\:ascii.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*readtoend.*")) AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*system\\\.io\\\.compression\\\.deflatestream.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*system\\\.io\\\.streamreader.*")))
